# RobustnessSpikeEncoding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for encoding 2D-3D point correspondences into spike trains with noise-tolerant temporal patterns, ensuring PnP accuracy under outlier correspondences. Addresses a key challenge in neuromorphic vision—robustness to noisy input—making iNEST systems viable for real-world, unstructured environments.
